title: RegulatorySourceRecord
description: Schema for authoritative QCO and CRS regulatory order records in StandSpec AI.

source_id.description: Unique regulatory source identifier matching source_manifest.json.

order_title.description: Official title of the quality control order or compulsory registration order.

order_number.description: Unique identifier or internal order ID.

issuing_authority.description: Ministry or department issuing the gazette mandate.

product_scope.description: Product categories subject to mandatory certification.

standard_designations.description: List of Indian Standards covered under this order.

scheme.description: Conformity scheme (e.g. Scheme-I (ISI Mark) or Scheme-II (Self-Declaration)).

retrieved_at.description: ISO timestamp of regulatory record retrieval.

evidence_excerpt.description: Verbatim gazette clause establishing legal mandate.
